info.name: Public Prewave Actions Suppliers - Sites Upsert API
Force the processing of all pending site upsert requests.

items.docs:
Trigger processing of all queued site upsert requests. Intended for administrative use.

**Required permission:** `sites_upsert_admin`

**Performance impact:** Medium

info.name: List all site upsert requests for your organisation.

items.docs:
List all site upsert requests for your organisation. The organisation is determined by your API user or API token.

**Required permission:** `create_sites_upsert_requests`

**Performance impact:** Low

info.name: Upsert suppliers and their desired collections with a full load.

items.docs:
Full load means that all sites need to exist in the request payload.
Existing sites not part of the payload will be removed from the managed collections in this request.

**Required permission:** `create_sites_upsert_requests`

**Performance impact:** Medium

info.name: Upsert suppliers and their desired collections with a delta load.

items.docs:
In contrast to the full load, the delta load only updates the sites in the payload.
Existing sites not part of the payload will not be removed from managed collections.

**Required permission:** `create_sites_upsert_requests`

**Performance impact:** Medium

info.name: Disable edges to suppliers and remove them from managed collections.

params.name: dryRun
params.description:
If set to true, the request will be processed without actually writing to the database.This is useful for testing purposes.
            |Use endpoints `{requestId}/dry-runs` and `dry-run/{id}` to get the status and the results of your dry-runs.
